in_hebrew.name: Haldi
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Haldi הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'Helios', meaning 'Sun' or 'Sun god'. In ancient Greek mythology, Helios was the god of the sun, and his name is the root of the English word 'helianthus', meaning sunflower.
